facts.business: Mask Investments Limited is a non-banking finance company (NBFC) whose registration was cancelled by RBI in 2018; it currently earns income from interest on loans and advances given to others and dividends from investments in group or associate companies.
key_risks: Adverse impact on business of group/associate companies affecting performance
facts.related_party_note: The company has granted unsecured loans to other parties (balance outstanding Rs. 108.98 lakhs as at balance sheet date) and made investments in companies, firms, and LLPs. Loans are repayable on demand or without specified repayment terms. No loans granted to promoters or related parties.
